entities.name: Kurdistan Communist Party – Iraq
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Communist Party of Kurdistan – Iraq is a Kurdish political party, formed in October 1993 when the Iraqi Communist Party branch in the Kurdish areas was formed into a separate party. The party is led by Kawa Mahmud.
